instruction: Locate every distinct directory under test_environment that has one or more .ipynb files, sort these paths, and output them to 'ipynb_directories.txt'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
